instruction: Update Chrome to use DuckDuckGo as the default search engine due to privacy preferences.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the Chrome default search engine to 'DuckDuckGo'. The evaluator uses the existing get_default_search_engine getter to extract the search engine name from Chrome's Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name) and compares it against 'DuckDuckGo' using exact_match. The postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are saved.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default search engine name from Chrome's Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric exact_match correctly compares result against expected value 'DuckDuckGo'
Expected value 'DuckDuckGo' is semantically correct for DuckDuckGo search engine
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (verifying default search engine is DuckDuckGo)
